acceptance.given: A fresh checkout, pinned inputs, and the original binding identity are available.

oracle.expected: Replay reconstructs the Exact Cover result equal to the pinned-input reference and records the same binding identity.
forbidden: Replay reports Exact Cover without reconstructing from the fresh checkout and pinned inputs.
Replay uses a changed binding identity or produces a different, incomplete, or unexplained result.
oracle.observable: Fresh-checkout replay receipt contains reconstructed input identities, same-identity replay evidence, and Exact Cover equality.

acceptance.then: The replay result is accepted only when the reconstructed Exact Cover equals the pinned reference under the original binding identity.
acceptance.when: The operator reconstructs the original binding identity from the fresh checkout and replays Exact Cover with that same identity.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Mutate a pinned input or binding identity and verify fresh-checkout Exact Cover replay is rejected as non-reproducible.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reconstruct the original binding identity, replay with that same identity, and reject identity or Exact Cover divergence.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay result schema and fail-closed terminal categories; no migration required.

slice_hint.state_transition: Fresh checkout and pinned inputs available -> original identity reconstructed -> same-identity replay -> Exact Cover equality or stale/rejected result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Replay receipt proves original binding reconstruction and same-identity execution, and Exact Cover equals the pinned reference; otherwise terminal result is unsuccessful.

acceptance.given: A detached positive Probe fixture and its declared command and target are available.

oracle.expected: Execution evidence proves the positive Probe ran as a separate operating-system process and binds its input, target, command, result, and output.
forbidden: The Probe is executed only in-process or simulated.
The receipt claims detached execution without an independent process identity or bound output.
oracle.observable: Probe execution receipt contains an independent process identity and bound input, target, command, result, and output evidence.

acceptance.then: The positive Probe execution is accepted only when an independent process boundary and complete binding evidence are observed.
acceptance.when: The detached positive Probe command is launched and its process and output receipt are inspected.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the detached-positive Probe selector and reject execution when it lacks an independent process boundary or complete input/output binding.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Launch the positive Probe through the real worker process and bind process, input, target, command, result, and output evidence.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve worker CLI and replay receipt compatibility; rollback restores prior detached-process invocation semantics.

slice_hint.state_transition: Positive Probe ready -> real worker subprocess launched -> process boundary and bindings observed -> pass or deterministic execution failure.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Receipt records a distinct worker process and complete bindings for the positive Probe; otherwise the Probe obligation fails.

acceptance.given: Target resolution is attempted for a repository-contained Toolchain package.

oracle.expected: Processing is denied or terminated when the resolved target escapes its permitted repository boundary.
forbidden: A target outside the allowed boundary is accepted.
oracle.observable: Target-resolution result or rejection receipt records boundary violation and no processing continuation.

acceptance.then: The target remains closed and no validation or replay processing proceeds for the escaping path.
acceptance.when: Boundary validation evaluates the resolved target path and detects that it escapes the permitted root.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Provide a traversal or out-of-root target to the target resolver and verify fail-closed rejection before processing.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce repository-boundary containment during target resolution and terminate processing on escape.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve target identity and fail-closed terminal categories; no schema migration required.

slice_hint.state_transition: Target resolution attempted -> containment check -> escaping target rejected and processing closed.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Boundary check emits a deterministic rejection and no downstream target processing occurs for an escaping path.

acceptance.given: A matrix aggregate is being computed from per-case evidence.

oracle.expected: When any matrix evidence is marked infrastructure-failed, the aggregate status is invalid and cannot be reported as valid.
forbidden: The aggregate is valid despite infrastructure-failed matrix evidence.
Infrastructure failure is silently treated as a passing or complete case.
oracle.observable: Aggregate result artifact records invalid status and identifies the infrastructure-failed evidence as the cause during matrix evaluation.

acceptance.then: The matrix summary remains invalid and downstream success determination is blocked.
acceptance.when: The matrix evidence aggregator evaluates case receipts and encounters an infrastructure-failed case.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Inject an infrastructure-failed matrix case into aggregate evaluation and verify the summary is invalid rather than valid.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Propagate infrastructure-failed case evidence into an invalid aggregate status and block success determination.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve aggregate status vocabulary and existing matrix evidence fields; no migration required.

slice_hint.state_transition: Matrix cases evaluated -> infrastructure failure detected -> aggregate marked invalid -> success blocked.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Aggregate artifact is invalid whenever any required matrix evidence has infrastructure-failed status; valid success cannot be emitted.
